## Requirements

1. A `government_mandated_disclosure` connector for municipal surveillance-ordinance (CCOPS)
   disclosures, through the P04.1 eight-stage framework + loader gate (GL-CCOPS-01; SIG-INGEST-049).
2. Per-agency AGGREGATE rows only (Part VIII — no person-level or non-aggregate CCOPS data).
3. A CCOPS disclosure fixture that ingests to typed claims; `procured≠deployed` enforced
   (a disclosure authorizing/procuring a system is not evidence it is deployed).
4. Rights packets + review for its sources (preparatory; no flips — HG-03/HG-04).
5. SIG-INGEST-049* PARTIAL→MET with test evidence; closes/retires OPEN FINDING P17-FLIP-01.
6. Re-confirm the P04.1 framework + loader-gate seam at build time.
